name: mention-guard
title: Mention Guard
description: Message box that says how many people @channel, @everyone or a group mention will notify and how many are in other time zones, flags mentioned people who aren't in the conversation, offers fixes, and turns Send into an explicit "Notify 1,240 people" confirm.

meta.summary: Says how many people @channel, @everyone or a group mention will notify as you type, and asks for an explicit confirm before a mass ping.
meta.server: Rate-limit and permission-check broadcast mentions on the server.
catches: Broadcast mentions over a threshold, with the count
Mentioned people who aren't in the conversation or can't open it
Double press on Send: the confirm can't be triggered by it
limits: Audience sizes come from your context prop
Doesn't stop sending through other clients or the API
Mentions are parsed with simple rules; custom mention syntax needs adapting
a11y: Visible label; textarea is described by a polite notice region
Escape cancels the armed confirm; IME composition doesn't trigger send
Confirm pulse is skipped under reduced motion
Fixes are buttons; icons are aria-hidden
